title: Port-in-use / no-Wi-Fi shows only STARTING; shell has no toast
body: RaceServer retries 10x then the status stays LinkText.STARTING; the activity has no on-screen word for failure. Seam: link RaceServer after retries should set a distinct status (e.g. Port busy / No Wi-Fi) and dr-tv-screens draw it.
